Mod.Name: AxlRose's Blender v1
Mod.Description:
- Fixes the "shadow/light" effect (blending) of the ground/floor for all affected Battle Stages - Improvements to the Battle Fields were done directly to the 3D model's floor meshes - Compatible with most Battle Texture mods
Important: - Place this mod below (After) other texture mods such as "SYW Battle Textures", "AxlRose's Battle Scenes" or "Avalanche Arisen" (Auto Sort)
